mwp.text: A tank contains 120 liters of water. 25 liters are used, then 18 liters are added. How many liters are in the tank now? Answer in liters as a number.
A runner completes 3 laps of 400 m and then 2 laps of 200 m. What is the total distance in kilometers? Answer as a number in km.
Muffins come in boxes of 6. You buy 5 boxes, give away 7 muffins, then bake 5 more. How many muffins do you have? Answer as a number.

pol.text: Policy: meals are reimbursable up to 20 dollars per day and alcohol is never reimbursable. Claim: one receipt with a 13 dollar sandwich and a 6 dollar beer. Return reimburse_meal_only, approve, or deny.
Policy: a taxi is reimbursable only if the receipt time is between 05:30 and 22:30 and the total is 45 dollars or less. Claim: 41 dollars at 22:40. Return approve or deny.
Policy: peripherals up to 80 dollars are approved without IT sign off, laptops always need prior IT approval. Claim: a 59 dollar mouse. Return approve or deny.
